h1: Crypto payments for remittance & cross-border payouts
subheading: Collect cross-border payments in Bitcoin, USDT, XRP, and 12+ other cryptocurrencies without correspondent banks, chargebacks, or holding periods
intro_paragraph: Traditional remittance corridors saddle you with 3-7% FX markups, 3-5 day settlement windows, and slow legacy rails that frustrate your customers. DynoPay delivers crypto payments directly to your wallet—no custody, no chargebacks, no monthly fees. Your customers pay in Bitcoin, stablecoins, or 15+ cryptocurrencies, and you receive funds in minutes in the wallet you control. Fees start at 1.5% and drop to 0.5% as your volume grows, with your first transaction completely free.

features.title: Funds hit your wallet directly
features.description: Non-custodial architecture means every payment lands in the wallet you specify during setup. DynoPay never touches your funds, so you maintain full control and can move capital immediately.

features.title: Stablecoins eliminate FX volatility
features.description: Accept USDT on Ethereum, Tron, and Polygon, plus USDC on Ethereum and RLUSD on Ethereum and the XRP Ledger. Your recipients get predictable value without exposure to Bitcoin price swings.

features.title: No chargebacks, ever
features.description: Crypto transactions are final. Once settled, funds cannot be reversed by a bank or payment processor, eliminating dispute losses that plague card-based remittance services.

how_it_works: Sign up, verify your email, create a company profile, and add the wallet address where you want funds sent.
Generate a payment link or embed the checkout widget on your platform for customers to pay in crypto.
Customers pay in their chosen cryptocurrency; funds arrive in your wallet within minutes, minus the platform fee.

faqs.question: How do crypto payments reduce costs for cross-border payouts compared to banks?
faqs.answer: Banks layer correspondent fees, FX spreads, and SWIFT charges that total 3-7% per transaction. DynoPay charges from 1.5% (dropping to 0.5% at volume) with no hidden fees, no intermediaries, and no currency conversion markups when using stablecoins.

faqs.question: Which stablecoins does DynoPay support for remittance businesses?
faqs.answer: DynoPay supports USDT on Ethereum, Polygon, and Tron networks, USDC on Ethereum, plus RLUSD on both Ethereum and the XRP Ledger. This gives your customers multiple low-fee options for stable-value transfers.

faqs.question: Do I need a crypto wallet before I start accepting payments?
faqs.answer: Yes. During onboarding you provide one wallet address per cryptocurrency you want to accept. Funds from every payment go directly there. You can use any non-custodial wallet like MetaMask, Ledger, Exodus, or a business treasury wallet.

faqs.question: How long does it take for cross-border crypto payments to settle?
faqs.answer: Bitcoin confirms in 10-60 minutes depending on network congestion. Ethereum, Polygon, Tron, and Solana payments typically confirm in under 5 minutes. XRP and Litecoin settle in 2-5 minutes. All are faster than traditional wire transfers.

faqs.question: Can customers in any country send me crypto payments through DynoPay?
faqs.answer: Yes. Crypto has no geographic limits on who can send funds to your wallet. Identity verification (KYC) applies to your DynoPay account once settled volume passes a threshold, fiat off-ramps run their own KYC, and as a remittance business you remain responsible for your own licensing and AML obligations.

cta_body: Sign up now and your first transaction is fee-free. No setup costs, no monthly fees, funds direct to your wallet.
